_comment: Per-env ceiling for server feature flags and Cloud Run shape. A revision may be promoted only if every flag's EFFECTIVE mode is <= the ceiling. Raising a ceiling is a reviewed PR. Allowlist uids are never stored here, only counts. Order: off < allowlist < percent < on.

unset_default._comment: Mode when FEATURE_<N> is unset, from backend/pkg/platform/config/config.go (graph/posts: on in dev, off in prod; all others off). check-flag-registry.sh re-derives this from config.go.
